_comment: Sample parameters file for XdrLogRaider v0.1.0. Copy to parameters.local.json, fill SA creds, then deploy via: az deployment group create --resource-group <rg> --template-file mainTemplate.json --parameters @parameters.local.json. NEVER commit parameters.local.json — gitignored.

projectPrefix._help: 1-6 lowercase alphanumeric prefix for all resource names · default 'xdrlr'.

location._help: Azure region for the connector resource group. Match your Sentinel workspace region for lowest cross-region egress.

workspaceResourceId._help: Full ARM ID of the Sentinel-enabled Log Analytics workspace. Required.

workspaceLocation._help: Location of the workspace · used for DCR association.

serviceAccountUpn._help: Dedicated Entra user for the connector. MUST have Security Reader + Microsoft Defender Analyst roles. Conditional-Access-exempted for unattended TOTP sign-in.

serviceAccountPassword._help: SA password. NEVER commit · use az keyvault secret show or pass via -p '<password>' at deploy time. Stored in deployed Key Vault.

serviceAccountTotpSecret._help: Base32 TOTP seed from SA's authenticator setup. Capture during MFA-enrollment QR. Stored in deployed Key Vault. Set to '' if AuthMethod=Passkey.

serviceAccountAuthMethod._help: MFA method · 'CredentialsTotp' (default) or 'Passkey'. Operator must enrol the SA accordingly. If Passkey · serviceAccountPasskeyPem REQUIRED below.

serviceAccountPasskeyPem._help: ECDSA-P256 PEM private key for SA WebAuthn passkey (begins with '-----BEGIN PRIVATE KEY-----'). REQUIRED when serviceAccountAuthMethod=Passkey · ignored when CredentialsTotp. Register the corresponding public key via mysignins.microsoft.com prior to deploy.

githubRepo._help: Owner/repo for cosign keyless OIDC + release-tag traceability. Used in AppInsights customDimensions.

releaseTag._help: Git tag of the release being deployed. Validated against githubRepo at runtime for tampering detection.

connectorVersion._help: Connector SemVer. Emitted in every row's ConnectorVersion column for downstream filtering.

planSku._help: Function App plan SKU. Y1 = Consumption (recommended) · EP1 = Elastic Premium (for higher SLA).

deployRoleAssignments._help: Set $false if deploying identity lacks User Access Administrator · then run tools/Grant-Post-Deploy-Rbac.ps1 separately.
